central_unknown: McLaren's form appears to have dropped significantly at Austin compared to Mercedes and Ferrari, making it unclear whether they deserve a spot in lineups. Additionally, the pecking order between Mercedes' two drivers and Ferrari's Leclerc remains tight and hard to separate.

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: Max Verstappen
captains.reason: ML projects 26.1 exp pts (39.3 proj), ppm 1.81, MEDIUM risk, predicted to qualify P3 and finish P1. Verstappen is the clear ML #1 captain recommendation and aligns with FanAmp's preference for backing Max over Russell. Historically strong at COTA. DNF risk 0.14 is manageable.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: George Russell
captains.reason: ML projects 24.4 exp pts (30.6 proj), MEDIUM risk, pred quali P4 → finish P2. Russell has strong upside if Mercedes' pace holds. However, ppm is only 0.68 — the lowest among the top 4 drivers — making him expensive for his output. FanAmp showed hesitation on Russell in penalty scenarios but here he's not penalized. A differential pick if you believe Mercedes can lock out the podium.

buy.name: Isack Hadjar
buy.note: ML projects 8.9 exp pts, ppm 1.21, value 0.55. Budget-friendly with Racing Bulls providing a competitive midfield car. Key budget builder with low price threshold for rises. Consensus pick across channels as a must-have budget driver.

buy.name: Arvid Lindblad
buy.note: Floor-price driver on Racing Bulls. FanAmp highlighted his ability to gain positions from lower grid slots (8-10 pts in sprints). Essential budget filler who can gain price rises with minimal scoring.

buy.name: Nico Hulkenberg
buy.note: At or near price floor — cannot lose further value. BoxBoxF1Fantasy channels consistently recommend him as insurance. In 96.2% of top 500 Global League teams per FanAmp.

consider.name: Charles Leclerc
consider.note: ML projects 22.4 exp pts, ppm 1.33, value 0.93, pred quali P2 → finish P3. Strong value among premium drivers. BoxBoxF1Fantasy noted Leclerc trending upward. Close to Hamilton in expected points but better ppm.

consider.name: Lewis Hamilton
consider.note: ML projects 19.0 exp pts, LOW risk, DNF only 0.10. Stable floor but lower ceiling than Leclerc (proj 19.2 vs 27.4). Pick if you need safety over upside.

consider.name: Liam Lawson
consider.note: BoxBoxF1Fantasy channels consistently list Lawson as a no-brainer budget builder. Low price, easy price rise threshold.

avoid: Sergio Perez — BoxBoxF1Fantasy explicitly warns away; poor performance relative to price
Lando Norris — ML projects only 15.6 exp pts at 26.1M, ppm 0.29 (worst among top 8), MEDIUM risk with 0.18 DNF probability; McLaren's form questionable at Austin
Oscar Piastri — ML projects 17.4 exp pts at 23.4M, ppm 0.50; McLaren underperforming expectations
Franco Colapinto — mentioned as a budget builder in earlier rounds but no strong Austin-specific case

chips.name: 3x Boost
chips.reason: BoxBoxF1Fantasy activated 3x at Monza when Mercedes dominated and showed it can outscore Limitless. If Mercedes + Verstappen lineup looks dominant after FP sessions, 3x on Verstappen or Antonelli could be powerful. Evaluate after practice.

chips.name: Limitless
chips.reason: BoxBoxF1Fantasy showed Limitless scored lower than 3x Boost at Monza. Save for a sprint weekend or a race with clearer dominance from expensive drivers.

chips.name: Wildcard
chips.reason: No compelling restructuring need this week. Multiple channels suggest saving Wildcard for maximum budget-building opportunities at upcoming races.

chips.name: 4A (Autopilot)
chips.reason: BoxBoxF1Fantasy activated 4A at Zandvoort with a clear top-heavy field. Austin's tighter midfield spread doesn't strongly favor 4A over manual picks.

watch_items: Mercedes aero package split between drivers — older spec proved faster at Baku; monitor which package performs better at COTA's unique surface
McLaren's pace deficit — ML has both Norris and Piastri well below Mercedes/Ferrari/Red Bull; watch FP sessions to confirm if McLaren is truly off the pace
Verstappen DNF risk at 0.14 — COTA has historically produced incidents; any first-lap contact could turn a captain pick negative
Antonelli qualifying — ML predicts P1 quali but only P4 finish, implying race pace may not match one-lap speed; FP long runs will clarify
Weather — BoxBoxF1Fantasy consistently monitors rain probability; any wet session reshuffles the grid and creates overtake opportunities
Engine penalties — FanAmp noted Russell likely needs a second engine penalty later this season; if taken at Austin rather than expected, that changes scoring calculus dramatically
arc: The United States GP is the first of a crucial late-season triple-header stretch. Mercedes appear to have the strongest overall package (ML projects them at 65.1 exp constructor pts), making Antonelli and Russell premium holds through the final races. Budget building remains critical — drivers like Hadjar, Lindblad, and Lawson should be locked in now to accumulate price rises for the season finale push. McLaren's apparent regression at Austin needs monitoring: if it continues into Mexico and Brazil, pivoting away from McLaren constructor permanently and redistributing that budget into Ferrari or Red Bull becomes the dominant strategy. Save chips for sprint weekends or races where one team clearly dominates practice sessions.
